plugins.name: red-team-brief
plugins.description: Strengthen a legal draft in five layers or audit an adverse judgment for appeal. For licensed lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: devils-advocate
plugins.description: Ruthless opposing-counsel mode: attacks your legal position, idea, or document, strongest arguments first. Legal and general modes. For licensed lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: litigation-strategy
plugins.description: Litigation strategy advisor for civil and commercial disputes: dispute map, 2-3 lines of position with their price, enforceability, stage tactics, appeal map. Jurisdiction-neutral, common-law lens. For licensed lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: criminal-defense-strategy
plugins.description: Strategy advisor for criminal defense counsel: case map, lines of defense with their price, evidence attack, stage tactics, appeal map. Jurisdiction-neutral, common-law lens. For licensed defense lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: criminal-defense-drafting
plugins.description: Drafting assistant for criminal defense counsel: bail, exclusion and dismissal motions, disclosure applications, appeal grounds, submissions, cross-examination outlines, expert questions. Formal register, no invented authority. Jurisdiction-neutral. For licensed defense lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: client-explainer
plugins.description: Turns legal analysis into plain-language client communications: reply, memo, FAQ, explanation of a decision. Honest about risk. Jurisdiction-neutral. For lawyers; not legal advice.

plugins.name: legal-prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Turns a lawyer's short request into a strong structured prompt for an AI model, with guardrails against invented authority, plus a library of six ready prompts. Jurisdiction-neutral. For lawyers; not legal advice.
